# Dawn transit network analysis {background-iframe="https://lxparapessoas.github.io/rede-madrugada/?iframe=true&map=parishes&play=true&color-mode=light&center=38.652343,-9.486546" auto-animate=true} 

🌆🌃🌇 

By Gonçalo Matos, for Lisboa Para Pessoas


## 💡 Motivation {.smaller autp-animate=true}

::: {.incremental}
- **Night-time public transport is common** in European cities [@plyushteva_does_2020]

- It can have positive impacts on **road safety** [@lichtman_sadot_can_2019] and contribute to **local economy** [@transport_for_london_night_2015]

- Lisbon has them, but with **low frequency and poor connections to the outskirts**, despite 81% of the Metro Area inhabitants living outside the city [@ine_populacao_2021]

- Mobility dynamic at night is **not limited to Lisbon** [@ine_mobilidade_2018]
:::

:::{.fragment}
![Night displacement density (19:00-04:00) by destination municipality [@ine_mobilidade_2018]](figures/aml_night_density.png){width="65%"}
:::

::: {.notes}
26 of 28 capitals had night services it in 2019

Carris night connections (7) only connect to to Oeiras, Amadora, Loures and Odivelas

Metro shuts down at 1am, trains and boats at 2am (Seixal, Montijo and Trafaria before that)
:::

## 💡 Motivation {.smaller autp-animate=true}

::: {.incremental}
- Problem acknowledged by experts, that state a **"mismatch with people's needs and economic activities"** [@tml_relatorio_2024]

- Carris Metropolitana **night network launch has been a success**, with increases in demand up to 117% [@carris_metropolitana_desde_2025]
:::

:::{.fragment .center}
![](https://backoffice.carrismetropolitana.pt/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Banner.png){width="50%"}
:::
